title: Galatians Bible Quiz - Chapter 1
description: Ten questions on Galatians 1: a different good news, Paul's apostleship through revelation, his past in the Jews' religion and his first years after being called.

questions.text: Through whom does Paul say his apostleship came?
questions.explanation: He writes that he is an apostle not from men, nor through man, but through Jesus Christ and God the Father, who raised him from the dead.

answers.text: Through Jesus Christ and God the Father
Through the assemblies of Galatia
Through the apostles in Jerusalem
Through the brothers who were with him

questions.text: Why does Paul say Christ gave himself, according to the opening greeting?
questions.explanation: He says Christ gave himself for our sins, that he might deliver us out of this present evil age, according to the will of our God and Father.

answers.text: To build a new temple on the earth
For our sins, to deliver us out of this present evil age
To gather all the nations to Jerusalem
To give the law to Israel a second time

questions.text: What does Paul marvel at in this chapter?
questions.explanation: He marvels that they are so quickly deserting him who called them in the grace of Christ, turning to a different good news.

answers.text: That they keep the traditions so strictly
That they give so little to the poor
That they are so quickly deserting him who called them
That they have forgotten his name

questions.text: What does Paul say should happen to anyone who preaches another good news?
questions.explanation: He says that even if he himself or an angel from heaven preached any good news other than what they preached, let him be cursed.

answers.text: He should be questioned by the elders
He should be sent back to Jerusalem
He should be heard and then judged
He should be cursed

questions.text: How does Paul say he received the Good News he preaches?
questions.explanation: He says he did not receive it from man, nor was he taught it, but it came to him through revelation of Jesus Christ.

answers.text: Through revelation of Jesus Christ
From the brothers in Damascus
From the apostles before him
From the traditions of his fathers

questions.text: What does Paul say he did to the assembly of God in time past?
questions.explanation: He says they have heard of his way of living in the Jews' religion, how beyond measure he persecuted the assembly of God and ravaged it.

answers.text: He supported it with gifts of money
He prayed for it in secret places
He persecuted it beyond measure and ravaged it
He argued with it in the synagogues

questions.text: Where did Paul go instead of going up to Jerusalem to the apostles before him?
questions.explanation: He says he did not confer with flesh and blood, nor go up to Jerusalem, but went away into Arabia and then returned to Damascus.

answers.text: To Syria and Cilicia
Into Arabia
To the regions of Judea
To Antioch

questions.text: How long did Paul stay with Peter when he went up to Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: He says that after three years he went up to Jerusalem to visit Peter and stayed with him fifteen days.

answers.text: Three days
A whole year
Forty days
Fifteen days

questions.text: Which other apostle does Paul say he saw on that visit?
questions.explanation: He says that of the other apostles he saw no one except James, the Lord's brother.

answers.text: James, the Lord's brother
John the son of Zebedee
Barnabas of Cyprus
Andrew, the brother of Peter

questions.text: What did the assemblies of Judea only hear about Paul?
questions.explanation: They only heard that he who once persecuted them now preaches the faith that he once tried to destroy, and so they glorified God in him.

answers.text: That he had been imprisoned in Damascus
That he had been taught by the elders
That he now preaches the faith he once tried to destroy
That he had returned to the traditions of his fathers
